evidenceKind: Read-only Unity source material extraction, compiled shader operation audit, archived source preview metadata and canonical GLB material comparison

publicationPolicy.applicationScope: Runtime correction is limited to published gameBuildId 25306743 and exact source shader/material names. Future exporters should preserve both primary BaseColor and Tint semantics for these named fungal materials.
publicationPolicy.provenanceRequirement: Keep original published metadata and distinguish installed-only primary evidence from direct old-build matches. Source values are not a hand-selected palette.

compiledColorOperation.semanticFormula: base = _BaseColor.rgb * mix(vec3(1), BaseTexture.rgb, _BaseTexAmount); layered = mix(base, _Color1.rgb, mask1); layered = mix(layered, _Color21.rgb, mask2); layered = mix(layered, _Color3.rgb, mask3); tinted = layered * _Tint.rgb; hue adjustment is optional; lit output is multiplied by mix(vec3(1), vertexColor.rgb, _VertexColorAmount).
compiledColorOperation.layerMaskMeaning: Each source color layer uses its authored sampled mask, optional flip, smoothstep Remap and that layer color alpha. Mask1 optionally restricts the second layer. Color alpha is a blend weight, not material opacity.
compiledColorOperation.legacyTopFields: This current shader does not declare _TopColor, _TopSurfaceTightness or _UseTopColor. Their obsolete saved values must not cause a white world-normal top layer on Glow Shroom.
omittedFromCorrection: authored multilayer masks and spatial color variation
compiledColorOperation.outputAccuracy: The named correction fixes the wrongly selected neutral Tint input and applies the actual Tint multiplier. It does not claim full shader parity.

nativePrefabClassification.statusTerminology: Native statusType10 is Spores; Poison is statusType3. Dangerous giant caps are called Evil variants in source, and should not be conflated with the small M_SporeShroomPoison fungi.

sporeCloudException.meaning: An ordinary cap material can coexist with a separate spore cloud. Material color alone must not be treated as a universal safety classifier.

materialGroups.role: Pale outer bell shell; preserve this material and this submesh.
Small mostly downward-facing underside/rim; uses the same authored red input as ordinary flat/dome cap.

roundMushroomShell.shapeDistinction: Round Top Mush mesh is the dome-style cap; Sphere top Mush mesh is the pale bell-style Round Variant. Do not color a whole object using its name.
roundMushroomShell.correctionRule: Correct only the exact material on its original primitive. Do not replace all materials on a cap-shaped mesh or alter M_MushroomBase to red.

Level_17.finding: The shown Level_17 static scene contains ordinary cap materials. Other published dates retain their distinct Evil materials; there is no evidence of exporter-wide replacement of Evil by ordinary caps.

limitations: Old 25306743 shader bytecode was unavailable; the operation audit is against installed 25739797.

Old 25306743 ordinary cap primary color and flags directly match archived source metadata; old Evil and Glow primary colors were not available, so those primary corrections use explicitly labeled installed-only evidence.
All three named Tint values and flags match old published GLB metadata exactly. This supports the multiplier inputs without proving complete material identity across builds.
Archived PNG previews are deterministic model renders with approximated shader/lighting, not game screenshots. Their prose color descriptions cannot override their actual material group data.
The correction must retain the source distinction between ordinary giant caps, Evil giant caps, glow clusters and existing small hazardous fungi.
